title: Ecommerce Video Ads: Formats, Examples, and Testing
summary: Build ecommerce video ads from product pages and owned assets. Choose formats, create distinct angles, review fidelity, and run useful creative tests.
body_markdown:
## Design a controlled test


Begin with three angles and one audience. Produce two hooks for each, keeping the offer and landing page constant. For the strongest angle, compare UGC with demonstration or animation. Name every asset by angle, format, hook, duration, ratio, and version.


Measure attention and watch behavior as diagnostic signals, then clicks, landing-page behavior, conversion, and contribution margin. Do not declare a winner from a high view rate alone.


## Common failure modes


- The product appears too late.
- The script could describe any competitor.
- Packaging or labels mutate.
- The presenter claims an experience that is not real.
- The offer is unreadable or expired.
- Vertical assets are center-cropped horizontal videos.
- Every “variant” changes several variables.


## Scale a winner


Preserve the winning promise and proof. Refresh the first frame, hook, presenter, duration, format, use-case setting, and seasonal context in controlled steps. Change the entire concept only after the mechanism stops working or the market changes.
